Starting the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, then compile a comprehensive report with screenshots.

Completed the home feed and sports page audit. Now moving to category pages (Weather, Economics, Championship Grids). Found several critical issues including 0% probabilities on golf cards, 99%/1% on resolved matches, impossible 0-0 baseball final scores, and future-dated games marked as FINAL.

I have completed the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. The site has a clean design and excellent data visualizations, but I found several critical data quality and freshness issues. 

Key findings include:
1. **Critical Data Issues:** The Golf grid has broken placement probabilities (showing 99% or 1% incorrectly) and impossible daily changes (-100%).
2. **Stale/Impossible States:** The Sports page shows future-dated games as "FINAL" and impossible 0-0 final baseball scores.
3. **Missing Filters:** The main home feed lacks the required sport filter pills, which are only available on the dedicated `/sports` page.

The complete audit report and relevant screenshots have been attached for your review. Let me know if you need any further analysis!
